policy: Prefer authoritative parent taxonomy IDs. Suggested IDs below describe semantic targets and must not be assumed to exist. Preserve raw tags during migration and record lossy mappings explicitly.

business_type_mapping.note: A holding is not automatically interchangeable with every multibusiness company.
Multiple products do not automatically constitute separate business units.

business_stage_mapping.note: Market entry may be a new market for an otherwise mature business; preserve entry context separately.
Can coexist with multiple lifecycle stages; do not force into maturity or decline.

fallback: If only a single business_types list is supported now, preserve multidimensional tags and publish dimension metadata. Do not use a blanket all-businesses alias to erase narrower applicability.
evidence_status: Editorial taxonomy design proposal, not source-derived business categorization or validated recommendation rules.
